globalRules: the homepage selector lists canonical classes from BuildsHomePayload.classOptions and never synthesizes a class
the homepage displays only a class selection; specialization and hero-talent choices remain inside downstream tools
the four command cards are static peers in the fixed order talents, gear, simc, tasks and do not express a workflow

tasks navigates directly to tasks_list without class or specialization context
no DPS, ranking, tier, BiS, player identity, template content, task history, or simulation result is inferred
